question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Crude
solution:
The correct answer is: **Refined**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Crude"** means something that is in a natural or raw state; not yet processed or refined. (अशोधित)

 
 
• **Example:** The **crude **oil needs to be processed before it can be used as fuel.
 
 
 
• **"Refined"** refers to something that has been made pure or improved, often by removing unwanted elements. (परिष्कृत)
 
 
• **Example:** The **refined **sugar is much smoother and free of impurities compared to raw sugar.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Crude'** is **'Refined'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Patient** (धैर्यवान): Able to accept or tolerate delays, problems, or suffering without becoming annoyed or anxious.

 
 
• **Example:** She was very **patient **while waiting for her turn at the doctor's office.
 
 
 
• **Primitive** (आदिम): Relating to the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The tools used by early humans were quite **primitive **compared to modern technology.
 
 
 
• **Observant** (ध्यान देने वाला): Quick to notice or perceive things.
 
 
• **Example:** He is very **observant **and rarely misses any detail.
